label: Left/Right camel-case limb names with the spine numbered from the top
notes: For 24-bone auto-rig skeletons (more with fingers) with camel-case Left/Right names: Hips, three spine joints named Spine (top, where the neck and shoulders attach), Spine01 and Spine02 (lowest), neck, Head, and Left/Right Shoulder, Arm, ForeArm, Hand, UpLeg, Leg, Foot, ToeBase. Finger joints, when the service adds them, use camel-case names (LeftHandThumb1 to 3 and so on; one generation service documents LeftHandThumb1, the rest follow that pattern unchecked). Spine01, head_end and headfront stand at no landmark and are reported as unmapped. Checked against rigged files returned by two generation services. Skeletons that number the spine from the bottom (Spine, Spine1, Spine2) and prefix every name: use left-right-camelcase-spine-from-hips.json.
